purpose: Restore exactly one mismatched application/document/script-focus state without bundling unrelated recovery.
trigger: Use when one state mismatch is located and expected state is known.

inputs.name: mismatched_state
inputs.description: One mismatch with mode explicitly window, document, or script_focus.

inputs.name: expected_focus_or_document
inputs.description: Expected target identity for that one mode.

preconditions: Exactly one recovery mode is selected.
Target identity is unique and recovery will not discard user work.

outputs.name: restored_state
outputs.description: Mode, target identity, action observation, and final state.

outputs.name: needs_manual_review
outputs.description: True when one-state recovery cannot be safely observed.

postconditions: Only selected window, document, or script-focus state changes.
Final state is observed and remaining mismatch is explicit.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim V21 desktop session with the target window kept maximized unless a recorded layout exception applies.
implementation.notes: The controller performs one bounded GUI action or observation; it must not expand this contract into a workflow. One state only: window, document, or script focus; composite recovery remains caller-owned.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: More than one state mode is requested or target is unclear.
Selected state remains mismatched after one action.

recovery.action: Split into one state atom and retry.
Return needs_manual_review or invoke caller's next ordered state operation.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Only selected window, document, or script-focus state changes.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
